title: Rasterpiece Theater
description: A mod that adds the FNaF franchise to Minecraft. This mod is more survival-based than creative.
body:
# Rasterpiece Theater
**About**

This NeoForge mod adds the Fazbear Franchise to your world.

  You get to play Minecraft, but with animatronics. The mod adds many blocks to craft that allow you to build your own Restaurants! Many animatronics to create and profit from.

**Features**

  Basic FNaF 1 Blocks
  
  Parts for the FNaF 1 gang
  
  A lot of food items
  
**Planned Features**

  Other Games: Adding FNaF 2 - SoTM

  Haunting: The animatronics become haunted by killing any type of villager within 5 blocks or a villager child within 10 blocks.
  
  Campaign Mode: Where you can create a campaign for others to play.

**Installation Requirements**

  Minecraft 1.21.1
  
  NeoForge
